items.author: Pico Iyer
items.text: Our lives are measured by the other selves inside us that we walk away from.

items.author: Mimi Morgan
items.text:
Good morning. ☕️

Don't confuse a familiar life with a finished one.
We get so used to our routines, our circumstances, even our own identities, that we stop leaving room for surprise.
But life doesn't ask permission before offering something extraordinary.

The only question is whether we'll still recognize it.
Leave a little room today.

items.author: J.K. Lundblad | Teaching Progress
items.text:
Decarbonization seems to be a byproduct of technological improvement.

Each step up the energy ladder from wood to coal to oil to natural gas 
led to greatly improved thermal efficiency, reduced pollution, reduced CO2 emissions.

In fact, each step reduced CO2 emissions by 30 percent per unit of energy!
